text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6577

g.text: Source: EFAS flood hazard maps (JRC), GHS-OBAT, GHS-POP 2020 (challenge data); OpenStreetMap. Team analysis. Zones are modelled with no dikes or flood walls, so towns behind them (Liège, Venlo) are an upper bound. Residents are an order of magnitude. Municipalities: GISCO LAU 2021. Shelters are candidates, not official (1.5 km walk, 4 m² per person). Counts rounded to 10.
